title: Show HN: Tilde.run – Agent sandbox with a transactional, versioned filesystem
summary: Tilde.run is a cloud-based agent sandbox platform that provides AI agents with a transactional, versioned filesystem environment. It allows developers to safely run and test AI agents with filesystem snapshots and rollback capabilities, similar to git but for agent execution states.
problem_solved: Provides safe, isolated environments for AI agent execution with the ability to rollback and version filesystem changes.
why_valuable: Eliminates risk in AI agent testing by offering transactional guarantees and version control, preventing state corruption from agent errors.
